DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_1aONE_1: Curiosity. Seek out. Similar molecules, Newcomer and me. Good.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_3aONE_1: Accept my dearest welcome from the bottom of THE KNIGHT’s illustrious heart, pristine fellow lost person. It seems Newcomer has been sent on an expedition far beyond the realms where one would normally travel. Here be dragons Newcomer. They glimmer like a dazzling array of diamonds at the dawn of a day that will see the heroics and bravery and determination of ones such as THE KNIGHT. And mayhap Newcomer too will face off against such insurmountable mountains that oppose one
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_1bONE_1: Jump in pool! No! Jump over pool. Water nice?. Air nicer?. Splash bad? Molecules touch skin. If safe, then stay. Corrosive? Newcomer not corrosive. Newcomer good. Newcomer lost key. No! Newcomer find key.
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_1cONE_1: Future good! Future uncertain. Uncertainty follows chaos. Chaos necessary. Otherwise heat death. Heat death boring! Remove the boring. Nothing can be boring? Ice is not boring. Yes! No, Ice gone. Please? Find ice block.
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_2bONE_1:
Music remembers
Newcomer composers for friends
The box is in past
The past is not here
Seek below as above comes
Walk the lobby stairs
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_2cONE_1:
Fortunate are they
Traverse together through floor
Newcomer must lie
Walk in solitude
Closer to greener pastures
Go too far in time
Stray from beaten path
Wandering the endless void
Find what will be lost
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_3bONE_1: The forces of evil have conspired against yours truly, THE KNIGHT. They will assault the walls of THE KNIGHT’s mind with all their strength but THE KNIGHT will never falter against such corrupt forces. For their will is but a pale reflection; like a white horse riding towards a lake. With the wind in THE KNIGHT’s hair, a storm is coming. One that shall blow away all evil deeds. Such as nightstands, closets, tables, and other evil pieces of furniture. Towering over THE KNIGHT with their similes like metaphors.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_3cONE_1: The future is uncertain. It’s the herald of death, famine, misfortune and the face. THE KNIGHT will never cower from such disastrous trappings. However, Newcomer must understand that heralding death -a black miasma with noble intent that sweeps justice- is not the path a true warrior of justice must take. However should Newcomer persist then THE KNIGHT might have a small favour to ask. Seek out THE KNIGHT when the future is most dilapidated and rotten and abandoned.
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_EC01_1: Splash! Mama lost again. Now the experiment can continue…. No? Why would I release toxic fumes? Ooooh! The big scary black rock in the sky? No this experiment is endothermic. I asked teacher and the black rain shouldn’t go boom. Shouldn’t? Yes mama, but science! Risk is necessary! I love you too mom. Endothermic reaction success! Mama happy! I get good grade in school. Why the black rock moving mama? Possible?
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_EC01_1:
My dear love undying
Winter’s chill took her from me
Love shall never spring
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_EC01_A: Well. This is a novel experience.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_EC02_A: I have no quarrel with you, good wall. But I must cross you.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_EC03_A: I command you, as Newcomer to move for me.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_EC05_1: I ride to glory! To the mill where I have worked tirelessly to impress the dazzling miller. He crushes flour like a knight crushes a delicate flower. But the miller is never impressed. Never does he compliment me on the showmanship I present when I try crushing the flour. He strikes the back of my head like the thunder that strikes an empty cave. Oh if we could but take shelter in that empty cave together from the pouring rain. But alas the miller’s only request is that I open a window. If only he would open the window to my mi- Oh crap that was a mirror.
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_1aTWO_1: Planet. Decay. Not end. New possibilities. Safe.
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_1bTWO_1: This place uncertain. Too much uncertainty. Stability disappears. Increase the heat to prevent ice forming. Newcomer prefers water. Newcomer forgot. Newcomer must not forget. Not again! Forget erodes stability? Or forget part of stability? Why is forgetting needed?
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_1cTWO_1:
Basement bad. Choice made. Choices unmade. Choice made. Choices unmade. No choice, yes stability. Choices dangerous. Newcomer must chose. Newcomer not choose basement. Newcomer not choose? No!!! Newcomer must choose. Newcomer has chosen and must choose again….
Question?
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_2bTWO_1:
Newcomer can’t stop
End is inevitable
Blind leading the blind
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_2cTWO_1:
Happiness is choice
Choice starts inevitable
There never was choice
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_3aTWO_1: Oh, how I have long awaited the long-awaited thrilling conclusion to my endless journeys along the abyss of the heart. For I have seen in the depths of my soul, Newcomer and I -the great knight of the new Dawn- will always know that nothing shall stand in my way. Except mayhap those woefully tasty “pompouses”
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_3bTWO_1: Oh woe is upon THE KNIGHT. For this darkness. This endless, unceasing threat that endangers Newcomer and THE KNIGHT shall never stop gnawing away at us. It shall be like a ceaseless discharge, opening the very mouth of hell. Abandon all hope, ye who enter here. But if Newcomer holds fast against the endless ocean washing away our powers of light then mayhap, the small favour shall be carried out.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_3cTWO_1: Oh pristine Newcomer. Oh mighty herald of the past. Let your powers flow through THE KNIGHT once more. THE KNIGHT gapes in awe at Newcomer’s awesomeness. I drool and weep over what could have been. Newcomer understood the debased basement of doom. Newcomer understands that the basement is the forbidden fruit that we must resist. Unless THE KNIGHT is sundered.
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_RIP01_1: The black rock destroyed. Possible? I will make possible. Others must be safe again. No quantum entanglement anymore. I shall destroy the uncertainty principle. If I leave hotel. Newcomer must not stop me.
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_RIP01_1:
Be my guardian
Weapon for my summer’s wrath
Autumn must not come
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_RIP01_1:
You cannot possibly think you could ever hope to obtain my deepest darkest secrets that I guard with such fervor? I require a small favour from you and then you might delve into the depths of my mind.
You must be harmed by every room in this sacred sanctuary.
But in order to be harmed by every room you must obtain all knowledge of every room.
But for you see, in order to obtain every last sticky note you must also solve the riddle of steel.
However, in order to solve the riddle of steel, the sacred sanctuary must be aligned with yourself.
However, to align this scared sanctuary with yourself, you must also hasten to destroy the Void.
However, to destroy the Void you have to talk to me?
Wait, but to talk to me, you have to talk to me?
But you can’t talk to me until you have talked to me but that then requires you to talk to me which can’t happen because you have to talk to me?
Okay, wait I need a moment to clear my mind- and done. Did you do all of that?
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_RIPACCEPT_1: Perfect, I will now reveal the ultimate truth.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_RIPDENY_1: To prevent the fabric of space being torn I shall now reveal the ultimate truth.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_RIP02_1: I shall be like a warrior of paper, forever guarding the tactile feel of it. I shall not be bothered by the infinitesimal small cuts it attacks my fingers with. I shall carry the scars from the pages like badges of honour. Like the medal bestowed upon a knight by the prince after a long and arduous quest. No fear is creeping in. No waves are crashing upon the desert of my mind. I remain resolved and steel my nerves against the deep ocean. The abyss shall not hurt the pages! I will strike down the water with my mighty sword. It was made with the purpose to defeat my enemies with ornate engravings with blessings of the miller upon them. Let his winds carry me far beyond the wheels of the mill. I shall sail the desert and the water shall tremble before me.
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_1BTWO_1: Sticky notes useful! Maybe leave. Left behind. For science! Science opens doors. Kaboom! No? Newcomer told me. Sticky notes no. Experiment other. Why?
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_1CTWO_1: Newcomer likes basement. Basement yes? No! No science. Only answers. Why? Questions good?
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_2BTWO_1:
Newcomer won’t write
End is desired for me
Stay blind forever
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_2CTWO_1:
Basement is not true
Newcomer avoids other floors
I hate false prophet
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_3BTWO_1: The ocean is smoke and mirrors. For I, THE KNIGHT have read the words of the messiah. Newcomer prophesied that salvation does not lie within the ocean of darkness. For it is a cruel mistress with a temper to rival Newcomer. And temptation must be denied in order to reach the summit of salvation.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_3CTWO_1: Newcomer knows the paths of this labyrinthian halls of utter gargantuan magnitude better than all. All those who deny this truth are not pure enough of heart. Like a fragile red rose their heart withers and slithers through the endless hallways. Never shall they find their coveted basement.
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_1aTHREE_1: New planet. Black hole close. Unsafe. Unsafe! UNSAFE! UNSAFE! UNSAFE!
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_1bTHREE_1:
You remember big hot thing? That melt ice? It has dial. Newcomer loved switching the dial to basement. Can you imitate Newcomer? Second thing you must do. Newcomer didn’t forsee this. The breaker short-circuited. You should go outside. Will you? You have to be right once you leave.
Hope!
DialogueDictionary.PH_brevity_1cTHREE_1:
You shall make big gathering building safe for us. Happy now! New possibilities open up for me. Much science to do with you! Touch molecules. Measure liquid streams. What’s your inside body pressure? I will touch the wall of big building. It is not like your skin. Why? Not important. Say hello to Newcomer for me. We never finished previous experiment.
Measure angles!
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_2bTHREE_1:
Locker is a lie
Unveil truth with opposite
Sound is opposite
A signal needed
Signal might seem lost to you
It resides in you
Turn signal to veil
Open locker with your mind
Find your lost core
DialogueDictionary.PH_haiku_2cTHREE_1:
The past unwritten
Your memories might persist
Free yourself from us
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_3aTHREE_1: A joyous occasion came upon me. A righteous feast was thrown in honour of my great heroics and bravery. For I had transcended the likes of a mere miller and the wheels of progress. I was content to say only a few words. And those few words echoed through the great halls of my forefathers who had constructed them of the properly measured wooden beams. And such as I was the great hero of the mill, it pales in comparison to the dazzling brilliance of Newcomer.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_3bTHREE_1: What have I spouted to you? I am but a miserable pile of secrets. I apologize to you. I tried shattering the mirror but couldn’t. Even when Newcomer entrusted me with this most important task. Even when he depended on me. I feared the Bellhop’s mirror more than I feared Newcomer’s wrath. Your questing has shown me that mayhap fear is not the unsurmountable mountain I thought it was. Mirror’s Peak is where your salvation lies. You mustn’t attempt to scratch the mirror. Snapshot it with the same sidearm that Newcomer used with such bravery and heroics.
DialogueDictionary.PH_prose_3cTHREE_1: Although I have delayed your spring, I hope that you can find clemency in your heart. Forgive me for my lies to you. Newcomer was the only one who I could trust until now. We are lost in this river of time. This prison of doom. We can only prepare ourselves for what is to come. I must not blame the shadow. It merely follows our actions. Whether you succeed or not, I hope that we stay friends.

ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PLAYER_ROOM_1: I have landed in some strange structure after trying to exit the Ash Twin Project with the Advanced Warp Core. The Core is missing.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_HOTEL_CURIOSITY_RUMOR_1: There is a sticky note on a desk in the lobby.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_HOTEL_CURIOSITY_RUMOR_2: The note mentions that the Signalscope can be used to enforce beliefs. There seems to be a signal behind the desk.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_HOTEL_CURIOSITY_1: Projecting my beliefs behind the desk revealed someone who calls themself the Bellhop. They revealed to me basic information about the hotel.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_OUTSIDE_RUMOR_1: There is a spot for a door at the front of the hotel lobby, but no door.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_OUTSIDE_RUMOR_2: The Bellhop claims he sees a door there.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_OUTSIDE_RUMOR_3: Purple mentioned that to leave the hotel, I will need to look at someone else's perspective who can see the exit. I will also need to make sure I leave with all my luggage.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_OUTSIDE_1: I took a picture of the Bellhop's perspective of the door, which made the door appear when I entered the lobby. I can now go outside.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_OUTSIDE_2: The outside of the hotel is dark and tranquil.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_OUTSIDE_3: I found an electrical box outside the hotel.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BASEMENT_RUMOR_1: There is a locked door behind the Bellhop. They say it leads to the basement.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BASEMENT_RUMOR_2: I reset the breaker power connected to the basement.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BASEMENT_RUMOR_3: I set the furnace heat to be sent to the basement. The door is warm to the touch
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BASEMENT_RUMOR_4: Blue mentioned that in order to unlock the basement, the breaker outside the hotel must be reset and heat sent to the basement.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BASEMENT_1: In the basement I found some kind of Ash Twin Project clone,
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BASEMENT_2: I removed a makeshift Advanced Warp Core from the system.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_FIRST_FLOOR_RUMOR_1: The Bellhop told me that most occupants live on the first floor.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_FIRST_FLOOR_1: The first floor is green, with long halls and a large number of rooms.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_VOID_FIRST_FLOOR_1: The hotel is being consumed by something the Bellhop calls "The Void." Something is messing with the objectivity of the hotel and making it malleable. However, this instability is causing it to be a prime target for this entity.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_POOLS_RUMOR_1: There is a locked room labeled "POOLS" on the first floor.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_POOLS_RUMOR_2: A sticky note mentioned that the key was taken by a denizen of the hotel, who was also messing with the wallpaper. The author could not bring themself to vandalize the wallpaper to see what they wrote under it.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_POOLS_1: The Pools are a nonsensical array of swimming pools spread across the floor, walls, and ceiling.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_SECOND_FLOOR_RUMOR_1: The Bellhop told me that when I visit the second floor, I should follow the signs or I will get lost.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_SECOND_FLOOR_1: The second floor is white and sterile, designed as a maze.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_VOID_SECOND_FLOOR_1: About three-quarters into the loop, the second floor gets consumed by the void. It is a broken maze.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_FURNACE_RUMOR_1: There is a furnace on the second floor.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_FURNACE_1: I located a furnace on the second floor.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_FURNACE_2: It has a valve that I can turn. It has notches labeled "B", "1", "2", and "3".
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_THIRD_FLOOR_RUMOR_1: The Bellhop told me that the third floor is supposed to be largely unoccupied, and he doesn't believe there are any locked doors up there.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_THIRD_FLOOR_1: The third floor is purple and more open space. There's not many rooms here.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_THIRD_FLOOR_2: I found a locked door at room [ID].
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_VOID_THIRD_FLOOR_1: Halfway into the loop, the top floor is consumed by the void.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_VAULT_RUMOR_1: I have found a safe of some kind that I can open. It is empty.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_VAULT_RUMOR_2: Green mentioned that if I lost something, it would have been put in the lost-and-found safe on the third floor. If I can't find it, I should project my belief that it exists when it's closed.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_VAULT_1: After projecting my belief of the Advanced Warp Core onto the empty safe while it was closed, it appeared when I opened it.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_PROSE_CURIOSITY_RUMOR_1: After speaking with the Purple Wisp, they began to emit a signal.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_PROSE_CURIOSITY_RUMOR_2: After speaking with the Purple Echo, they began to emit a signal.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_PROSE_CURIOSITY_RUMOR_3: After telling the Purple Ripple I had done all they asked, they allowed me to scan them.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_PROSE_CURIOSITY_1: Lining up the wisp with one of its aspects then projecting my beliefs with the Signalscope caused them to merge.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_PROSE_CURIOSITY_2: I merged all three aspects together into one being.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_WISP_RUMOR_1: I found a Purple Wisp hiding in one of the rooms.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_WISP_1: The Purple Wisp speaks in exhaustive prose.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_WISP_2: They mentioned an impassible barrier and a small favor.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_ECHO_RUMOR_1: Right outside of my room, there is a barrier blocking my access to part of the building.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_ECHO_1: I sent the hall back in time to before the barrier existed, which gave me access to a room with a Purple Echo.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_ECHO_2: The Purple Echo speaks in exhaustive prose.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_RUMOR_RUMOR_1: I found a Purple Ripple hiding in room [ID].
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_RIPPLE_1: The Purple Ripple speaks in exhaustive prose.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_RIPPLE_2: After speaking to them, they began to emit a signal.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_PURPLE_RIPPLE_3: I tried to scan their signal, but they would not permit it unless I did a small favor for them
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_BREVITY_CURIOSITY_RUMOR_1: After talking to the Blue Wisp, they began to emit a signal.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_BREVITY_CURIOSITY_RUMOR_2: After talking to the Blue Echo, they began to emit a signal.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_BREVITY_CURIOSITY_RUMOR_3: After talking to the Blue Ripple, they began to emit a signal.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_BREVITY_CURIOSITY_1: Lining up the wisp with one of its aspects then projecting my beliefs with the Signalscope caused them to merge.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_BREVITY_CURIOSITY_2: I merged all three aspects together into one being.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_WISP_RUMOR_1: I discovered a blue wisp in a room on the first floor. They speak with brevity.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_WISP_1: They mentioned splashing and a block of ice in a locked room.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_ECHO_RUMOR_1: I found a sticky note mentioning a temporal disturbance. It is apparently invisible akin to ghost matter. The author mused what might happen if it was impacted with high kinetic energy.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_ECHO_1: Hitting the disturbance created a bubble. It seems the bubble is back in time.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_ECHO_2: Within the bubble was a blue echo. They spoke with brevity.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_RIPPLE_RUMOR_1: I found a block of ice in room [ID] on the third floor of the Void Hotel.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_RIPPLE_RUMOR_2: I set the furnace to send its heat to the third floor. It was able to melt the ice.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_BLUE_RIPPLE_1: Within the block of ice was a Blue Ripple. They spoke with brevity.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_POETRY_CURIOSITY_RUMOR_1: After speaking with the Green Wisp, they began to emit a signal.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_POETRY_CURIOSITY_RUMOR_2: After speaking with the Green Echo, they began to emit a signal.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_POETRY_CURIOSITY_RUMOR_3: After speaking with the Green Ripple, they began to emit a signal.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_POETRY_CURIOSITY_1: Lining up the wisp with one of its aspects then projecting my beliefs with the Signalscope caused them to merge.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_POETRY_CURIOSITY_2: I merged all three aspects together into one being..
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_WISP_RUMOR_1: I found a green wisp on the second floor. They speak in poetry.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_WISP_1: They mentioned a music box and signs in a maze, changing with the time.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_ECHO_RUMOR_1: I found a music box. It is aged and out of tune.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_ECHO_1: I played the music box in the past where it was in tune, which revealed a secret compartment. In it was a Green Echo. They speak in Poetry.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_RIPPLE_RUMOR_1: I found a poem mentioning starting from a misspelled exit.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_RIPPLE_RUMOR_2: I found a poem saying to only go left until the flickering light.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_RIPPLE_RUMOR_3: I found a poem saying to try the locked door three times until it opened, then to visit in the void.
ShipLogDictionary.$PH_LOG_GREEN_RIPPLE_1: I found a Green Ripple. They speak in Poetry.
